game.title: World Geography Challenge
game.description: Oceans, capitals, borders, and hemispheres. A review of physical and political world geography, ranging from warm-up questions to two challenge items.

questions.prompt: Which is the largest ocean on Earth by surface area?
The capital of Canada is ___. (One word)
Counting its overseas territories, which country spans the most time zones?
Which of these countries are landlocked (no coastline on an ocean or sea)? Select all that apply.
Africa is larger in land area than North America.
The ___ Desert is the largest hot desert in the world. (One word)
The Strait of Gibraltar separates Spain from which country?
Which continent would you most like to study in more depth this term?
Name one country you would like to learn more about.
Which of these capital cities are located in the Southern Hemisphere? Select all that apply.
What is the current capital city of Kazakhstan?
